thought.text: npm install succeeded. Now start the full dev stack with `composer dev` in the background, as the guide specifies.

reasoning_content:
npm install succeeded. Next is Step 6 of the guide: `composer dev`, which launches `php artisan serve`, `php artisan queue:listen`, `php artisan pail`, and `npm run dev` (Vite) in parallel. This is a long-running foreground process. Need to launch it in the background, then verify the app at http://localhost:8000 and Vite at http://localhost:5173.

Let's use nohup to launch `composer dev` in the background, wait, then curl the endpoints.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && (nohup composer dev > /workspace/storage/logs/dev-server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 25 && tail -30 /workspace/storage/logs/dev-server.log", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start composer dev stack in background, show log"}

summary: Start composer dev stack in background, show log
